The '''Midani system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Midani/Legends|Midani]].
